interpretation.gate: Seed17 selected model scarcely separates histories on the fixed diagnostic validation pairs; seeds29/43 nearly preserve target pair amplitude. Later seed17 corrections grow while validation worsens. Supports an optimization/reader-learning failure, not replacing the original checkpoint-selection rule.
interpretation.motion: Long-gap sibling prediction amplitude is weaker than validation; absolute-time embeddings increase relative to visual embeddings and shifting age changes output. Supports testing a bounded relative-time reader with explicit observed-feature transport. Does not prove absolute-time embedding is the sole cause.
interpretation.counterfactual_warning: Age+16 with identical RGB/targets is a representation-sensitivity diagnostic, not a physically valid new test or a passing performance score.
